description: This Java source file defines the class 'DhlServices' which implements various DHL shipping operations such as request handling, rate estimation, registration, shipment confirmation, and response parsing within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for constructing XML requests, sending HTTP requests to DHL, and processing XML responses related to shipment and rate services, specific to DHL's API protocols.

classes.name: DhlConnectException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors during DHL connection attempts, extending GeneralException.

methods.name: sendDhlRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to DHL's API endpoint with the provided XML string, returning the XML response as a string.

methods.name: dhlRateEstimate
methods.description: Constructs a request to DHL's API to estimate shipping rates for a specific shipment, processes the XML response, and returns the estimated cost along with details.

methods.name: handleDhlRateResponse
methods.description: Parses the XML response from DHL's rate estimate service, extracts relevant data, handles errors, and returns structured rate information.

methods.name: dhlRegisterInquire
methods.description: Handles DHL account registration inquiries to obtain a shipping key, constructs request XML, sends it, and processes the response.

methods.name: handleDhlRegisterResponse
methods.description: Parses the registration response XML from DHL to retrieve the shipping key needed for further operations.

methods.name: dhlShipmentConfirm
methods.description: Prepares and sends a shipment confirmation request to DHL, processes the response to obtain tracking number and label image, and updates database records accordingly.

methods.name: handleDhlShipmentConfirmResponse
methods.description: Parses the shipment confirmation response, extracts tracking number and label image, decodes and stores label image bytes, and updates shipment records.

methods.name: createAccessRequestDocument
methods.description: Creates an XML document for DHL access requests with credentials and configuration parameters.

methods.name: handleErrors
methods.description: Processes XML response elements from DHL to extract and accumulate error messages based on Fault elements.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for DHL shipment gateway, either from database entities or properties files, supporting defaults.
